ggml-org/llama.cpp.name: b6700
ggml-org/llama.cpp.body: NVFP4 GGUF quantization type for Blackwell GPUs (GB10, RTX 50 series). CUDA graphs are now enabled by default on compute capability 12.x. Known issue: CUDA graphs crash on GB10 with some MoE models; pass --no-cuda-graphs or stay on b6690 until the fix lands. Vulkan: 12 percent faster prompt processing on Strix Halo.

ggml-org/llama.cpp.name: b6690
ggml-org/llama.cpp.body: Fix KV cache defragmentation on contexts above 64K. Vulkan matmul speedups.

vllm-project/vllm.name: v0.12.0
vllm-project/vllm.body: FP4 KV cache on Blackwell: up to 2x decode throughput on GB10 at batch 8 with no measurable quality loss on our evals. New speculative decoding defaults (EAGLE-3 when a draft head exists). DeepSeek V4 Flash day-0 support. Drops Python 3.9. Breaking: the --kv-cache-dtype auto default now picks fp8 on Hopper and Blackwell.

ollama/ollama.name: v0.13.0
ollama/ollama.body: NVFP4 model support on Blackwell GPUs, 1.8x faster prompt processing on the DGX Spark. New ollama ps --gpu view. Breaking: the legacy context field on /api/generate is removed; clients that still send it get a 400.

unslothai/unsloth.name: 2026.8.2: 3x faster LoRA on Blackwell
unslothai/unsloth.body: Triton kernels tuned for sm_121 (GB10). Gemma 4 and GLM-5 Air fine-tuning support. Fixes an OOM on 128 GB unified memory when gradient checkpointing is off.

sgl-project/sglang.name: v0.6.0
sgl-project/sglang.body: Prefill-decode disaggregation is GA. DeepSeek V4 Flash day-0 support with MLA kernels.

NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM.name: TensorRT-LLM 1.4.0 release candidate 1
NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM.body: NVFP4 weight-only quantization for GB10. Qwen 3.5 and Gemma 4 model support.

huggingface/transformers.name: v5.2.0
huggingface/transformers.body: Ten days old: must be dropped by the one-week release window.

open-webui/open-webui.name: v0.9.0
open-webui/open-webui.body: New side-by-side model comparison view. SSO fixes. Breaking: connections to Ollama older than 0.12 fail, update both.
